summary: The frozen Raw-child claim (o-3f7923b948de1d8b) is a necessary preexisting coverage gap for g0001 and g0002. The old harness prints only parser-produced trees, while both source versions support printing constructed Raw children.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions support constructing a Raw item, adding it to an array or object, and printing it as a child. A finite valid JSON input can supply the container and Raw text for such a setup. The complete parser dispatch produces no Raw item, and the complete old harness has no construction or insertion step, so no fuzzer input reaches this supported print behavior.

before.requirement: A valid input and supported setup containing a cJSON_Raw array or object child must be able to reach Raw child printing.
before.reason: The printer supports Raw and delegates array and object children to it. The parser dispatch cannot produce Raw, and the harness prints only the parser result.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array printing delegates each child to print_value.
Object printing delegates each child to print_value.
The public constructor creates a Raw item from supplied text.
The public object helper provides a supported setup with a Raw child.
The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case.
Array child parsing uses that dispatch.
Object child parsing uses that dispatch.

after.requirement: A valid input and supported setup containing a cJSON_Raw array or object child must be able to reach Raw child printing.
after.reason: Raw printing and child delegation remain supported. The parser still cannot produce Raw, and the fixed harness still prints only the parser result.
